description: Every non-procedural runtime file under assets/models, assets/textures and assets/materials. Each entry points to a provenance record by id. The asset validator fails when a runtime file has no entry.

assets.notes: Parametric PBR presets derived from the style guide palette (style.md section 3); their textures are procedural surfaces generated in code (src/assets/include/rv/assets/surface_textures.hpp), no image files.
UI sans for the product screens (style.md section 17.3), loaded by rv::ui::UiSystem; upstream fonts/ttf file, unmodified.
Bold weight of the UI sans; upstream fonts/ttf file, unmodified.
